NEW YORK —Boston Marathon favorites came out on top in Sunday's New York City Half Marathon.Hellen Obiri, a two-time winner in Boston, set a course record in the women's race. Sharon Lokedi, who won Boston last year, finished in second place on Sunday.On the men's side, Adriaan Wildschutt came in first.Eden Rainbow-Cooper, another Boston winner, finished first in the women's wheelchair.Daniel Romanchuk, the 2019 Boston Marathon winner, won the men's wheelchair.
